name: War Machine
description: A large automated machine left as bait for Urza.

description_citations.text: "Peace Talks at Kroog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weeks later Sharaman spots the War Machine and Urza leads an aerial assault; the automated machine shoots down every ornithopter but Urza's, and he destroys it by bombing.
timeline.quote: Urza managed to destroy the device by bombing it
